subject: tmux test socket leak fixed and machine cleaned, PR 289 green
result: Owner asked for cleanup of the working_environment_tmux_real.rs bloat. Root cause found: tmux kill-server stops a server but does not unlink its socket, and four of the five tmux test guards did nothing further, so every run of every tmux test leaked one inode permanently. This machine had 3131 accumulated under /tmp/tmux-501: 1985 aikit-install-test from mux_install.rs, 783 aikit-session-test from session_integration.rs, 297 aikit-space-provider from working_environment_tmux_real.rs, 9 aikit-w6 from working_environment_field_v2.rs which I introduced in the W6 work, plus assorted debug leftovers. tmux_real.rs was absent from the list because it already removed its socket correctly; its approach became the shared one. Fix on branch agent/tmux-test-socket-hygiene, PR https://github.com/EpiLogos/ai-kit/pull/289: an end_tmux_server helper per test crate that asks the live server for the socket_path format variable rather than rebuilding TMUX_TMPDIR/tmux-uid/socket from parts, with the reconstruction kept only as a fallback for an already-dead server, which is the case that most needs cleaning. Test hygiene only, no product code touched. Also fixed a real race in real_tmux_survives_adapter_restart: the test closes the session under test, which is that server last session, so tmux begins shutting the server down, and the test then rebuilt on the same socket and sometimes landed on a server already exiting, whose split-window then failed with no server running. Settled with the bounded poll the file already uses for pane readiness. Measurement is honest but not decisive: about two failures in fifty runs before and none in fifty after, with the socket directory emptied between the two measurements, so the race fix and the reduced directory pressure cannot be separated from outside. Machine state now: 3127 dead aikit sockets removed after checking each for a live server, none had one; the leaked aikit-sock-test probe server that had been running 31 days was killed; the owner research-canvas tmux session and the four non-aikit sockets default, oi-dev-test, probe-admin-8696 and sweepcheck were deliberately left alone. Verification: cargo test --workspace 243 binaries exit 0 with zero sockets leaked, clippy clean, CI green 20 pass 2 skip. Not merged; awaiting owner.
